summary.t: A set of 12 decorative baubles with personalised messages corresponding to the 12 Christmas wishes.

text.t:
More than just simple ornaments, these are 12 wishes filled with love, hope and magic to light up Christmas.
Each ball, made of white lacquered MDF and delicately cut, holds a special message to remind us of what truly matters: love, family, friendship, peace, joy, harmony, faith, love, and the passion of being together.
A set created with care to decorate the Christmas tree and fill every home with tenderness, togetherness and unforgettable moments.
The set of 12 is sold with a sleigh ball featuring the family name included, or each ball can be purchased individually.

options.escolha.values.conjunto.name.t: Set of 12, with the sleigh ball included

options.family.help.t: Will be engraved on the sleigh ball, included with the set of 12.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
